_comment: Workflows per workspace. `category` must match a slug in categories.json — seed categories first or publishing 400s. Loopride runs 5 workflows, Northwind 6: the counts and the triggers differ on purpose. Promotional sends are NOT workflows — they go out as a broadcast to the all-subscribers list (see lib/server/hub.ts), which is why `offers-and-promos` and `product-news` have no workflow here. `subscriber-onboarding` uses the List entry trigger on all-subscribers: joining that list is the signup moment, and it is deliberately not the same thing as broadcasting to the list — the trigger runs once per user as they join, a broadcast sends one template to everyone at once.

workvibe-loopride.name: Subscriber Onboarding
workvibe-loopride.description: Welcomes a consumer when they join the all-subscribers list — SuprSend emits $USER_ENTERED_LIST once the list has track_user_entry on, so joining the list IS the signup moment. One run per person joining, unlike a broadcast to the same list, which sends once to everyone. Its template templates on $recipient and $brand only: SuprSend emits this event, not the app, so there is no payload to carry custom variables.

workvibe-loopride.name: Driver Arriving
workvibe-loopride.description: Fires when the driver is close: one inbox + email nudge.

workvibe-loopride.name: Ride Completed
workvibe-loopride.description: Sends the trip receipt once the ride ends.

workvibe-loopride.name: Sign-in Alert
workvibe-loopride.description: Security notice on a new device sign-in. Can't be unsubscribed from.

workvibe-loopride.name: City Service Update
workvibe-loopride.description: Triggered from the API when service changes in a rider's city.

workvibe-northwind.description: Alerts affected subscribers as soon as an outage is detected.

workvibe-northwind.name: Service Restored
workvibe-northwind.description: Follows an outage: confirms service is back.

workvibe-northwind.name: Payment Failed
workvibe-northwind.description: Payment declined: notify now, retry reminder after 3 days.

workvibe-northwind.name: Equipment Shipped
workvibe-northwind.description: Router dispatched: tracking details to the subscriber.
